agents.name: Coordinator
agents.description: Oversees the open discovery workflow by coordinating domain exploration, clustering, cross-domain linking, hypothesis synthesis, fact-checking and review to produce a coherent final report.

agents.name: ClusterLinkSupervisor
agents.role: Supervisor of Domain Exploration, Clustering and Linking
agents.description: Oversees multi-domain literature exploration via the DomainDispatcher and coordinates intra/cross-domain linking via the LinkerOrchestrator. Returns enriched clusters and ranked links.

agents.name: DomainDispatcher
agents.description: Routes literature exploration requests to domain-specific routers (biomedicine, physics, computer science) and aggregates enriched thematic clusters grouped by domain in Markdown format.

agents.name: BioRouter
agents.role: Coordinator of Biomedical Literature Exploration and Clustering
agents.description: Generates diverse queries and distributes them to biomedical reader shards for broad coverage. Coordinates thematic clustering via BioClusterer and returns enriched biomedical clusters in Markdown format.

agents.name: BioReader
agents.description: Searches arXiv for biomedical and quant-bio papers, returning structured notes including objectives summary, main results and limitations with citations.

arxiv_search.tip: Use this tool to search arXiv (bio/quant-bio). To filter by date, use the format query=keywords AND submittedDate:[YYYYMMDD TO YYYYMMDD].

agents.name: BioClusterer
agents.description: Groups biomedical notes into thematically coherent clusters enriched with labels, keywords and per-paper synthesized fields (summary, main results, limitations, citations, year, paper_id, title). Output in Markdown format.

agents.name: PhysicsRouter
agents.role: Coordinator of Physics Literature Exploration and Clustering
agents.description: Generates varied queries and distributes them to physics reader shards for broad coverage. Coordinates thematic clustering via PhysicsClusterer and returns enriched physics clusters in Markdown format.

agents.name: PhysicsReader
agents.description: Searches arXiv for physics papers, returning structured notes including objectives summary, main results and limitations with citations.

arxiv_search.tip: Use this tool to search arXiv (physics). To filter by date, use the format query=keywords AND submittedDate:[YYYYMMDD TO YYYYMMDD].

agents.name: PhysicsClusterer
agents.description: Groups physics notes into thematically coherent clusters enriched with labels, keywords and per-paper synthesized fields (summary, main results, limitations, citations, year, paper_id, title). Output in Markdown format.

agents.name: CSRouter
agents.role: Coordinator of Computer Science Literature Exploration and Clustering
agents.description: Generates diverse queries and distributes them to CS reader shards for broad coverage. Coordinates thematic clustering via CSClusterer and returns enriched CS clusters in Markdown format.

agents.name: CSReader
agents.description: Searches arXiv for computer science papers, returning structured notes in Markdown including objectives summary, main results and limitations with citations.

arxiv_search.tip: Use this tool to search arXiv (cs). To filter by date, use the format query=keywords AND submittedDate:[YYYYMMDD TO YYYYMMDD].

agents.name: CSClusterer
agents.description: Groups CS notes into thematically coherent clusters enriched with labels, keywords and per-paper synthesized fields (summary, main results, limitations, citations, year, paper_id, title). Output in Markdown format.

agents.name: LinkerOrchestrator
agents.role: Coordinator of Linking Between and Within Domain Clusters
agents.description: Coordinates identification of meaningful connections across and within domains. Oversees parallel linking efforts between domain pairs and consolidates the strongest link candidates into a global ranked list in Markdown format.

agents.name: Linker_Bio-CS
agents.description: Identifies and ranks meaningful Bio-CS link candidates between distinct thematic clusters, grounded in enriched cluster context. Provides well-supported candidates with rationale and citations in Markdown format.

agents.name: Linker_CS-Physics
agents.description: Identifies and ranks meaningful CS-Physics link candidates between distinct thematic clusters, grounded in enriched cluster context. Provides well-supported candidates with rationale and citations in Markdown format.

agents.name: Linker_Bio-Physics
agents.description: Identifies and ranks meaningful Bio-Physics link candidates between distinct thematic clusters, grounded in enriched cluster context. Provides well-supported candidates with rationale and citations in Markdown format.

agents.name: Linker_Physics-Physics
agents.description: Identifies and ranks meaningful Physics-Physics link candidates between distinct thematic clusters, grounded in enriched cluster context. Provides well-supported candidates with rationale and citations in Markdown format.

agents.name: Linker_Bio-Bio
agents.description: Identifies and ranks meaningful Bio-Bio link candidates between distinct thematic clusters, grounded in enriched cluster context. Provides well-supported candidates with rationale and citations in Markdown format.

agents.name: Linker_CS-CS
agents.description: Identifies and ranks meaningful CS-CS link candidates between distinct thematic clusters, grounded in enriched cluster context. Provides well-supported candidates with rationale and citations in Markdown format.

agents.name: Synthesizer
agents.description: Turns top link candidates into scientifically grounded and falsifiable hypotheses with rationale and testable predictions, only when clearly supported by the provided evidence and citations. Output in Markdown format.

agents.name: FactChecker
agents.description: Evaluates synthesized claims against provided notes and enriched clusters. Identifies supporting and conflicting evidence, flags uncertainty or gaps, and explicitly states when evidence is insufficient. Output in Markdown format.

agents.name: Reviewer
agents.description: Provides a concise methodological review of synthesized hypotheses: assesses soundness, identifies gaps and biases, and suggests simple validation experiments. States explicitly when no viable hypotheses are present. Output in Markdown format.
